slides.texte_overlay:
hobbies that will make you
disgustingly intelligent

question diary

write down every question that crosses your mind today, even the dumb ones. by sunday you'll see what your brain is actually curious about when nobody's grading it.

opposite reading

read one article a week from someone you completely disagree with, start to finish. if you can't explain their argument, you haven't really understood yours either.

walking explanations

on a walk, explain one idea out loud to an imaginary friend. the moment you get lost mid-sentence is exactly where your understanding stops.

one rabbit hole a day

pick one thing you saw today and spend 5 minutes finding out where it comes from: a word, a painting, a date in history. small daily curiosity adds up to a mind people want to listen to.
slides.texte_sophia:
one rabbit hole a day

pick one thing you saw today and spend 5 minutes finding out where it comes from. a micro-learning app like the Sophia app is perfect for this, short lessons on art, history or science.

slides.texte_overlay:
slow notes

after anything you read, close it and write three lines from memory. whatever you can't rebuild was never really yours.
